# Bun HTMX Elysia CRUD - AI Project Overview

## Project Summary

This is a production-ready, server-side rendered web application template built with modern edge computing technologies. It demonstrates a complete CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) application with secure authentication, deployed on Cloudflare Workers at the edge for optimal performance and global availability.

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Install [Bun](https://bun.com) (package manager and test runner)
- Git clone or download this repository

### Local Development Setup
```bash
# Clone and setup
git clone https://github.com/nico-amsterdam/bun-htmx-crud.git
cd bun-htmx-crud
bun install
cp .env.example .env

# Database setup
bun migrate:create
bun migrate:dev

# Start development server
bun dev
# Open http://localhost:8787 in browser
```

### OAuth Setup (Optional for auth features)
- Configure Google OAuth: Follow `auth-setup-google.md`
- Configure GitHub OAuth: Follow `auth-setup-github.md`
- Set client secrets in `.env` file

### Deploy to Cloudflare
```bash
# Setup Cloudflare
bun wrangler login
bun create:db  # Create D1 database

# Configure and deploy
# Set DB_ID in .env (from wrangler.jsonc)
bun migrate    # Apply migrations
bun deploy:app # Deploy to Cloudflare
bun secret:google  # Set OAuth secrets
bun secret:github
```

### Essential Commands
- `bun dev` - Start development server
- `bun test` - Run test suite
- `bun typecheck` - Type checking
- `bun migrate:dev` - Apply local migrations
- `bun studio:db:dev` - View local database

## Core Technology Stack

- **Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers. Workers provide a subset of Node.js APIs
- **Web Framework**: Elysia (lightweight, high-performance, type-safe)
- **Frontend**: HTMX for progressive enhancement, server-side JSX rendering
- **Database**: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) with Drizzle ORM
- **Authentication**: OAuth2 with Google and GitHub providers
- **Deployment**: Cloudflare Workers (edge computing)
- **Language**: TypeScript with full type safety

## Key Features & Capabilities

### Security & Authentication
- OAuth2/OIDC integration with Google and GitHub
- Cryptographically signed session cookies with tamper protection
- CSRF protection with secure random tokens
- Content Security Policy (CSP) headers
- Fetch Metadata protection against cross-site attacks
- Session binding to IP address and user agent
- Comprehensive security headers and cookie configuration

### User Interface
- Server-side rendered HTML with JSX templates
- HTMX for dynamic interactions without full page reloads
- Hyperscript for lightweight client-side logic
- Responsive design with mobile compatibility
- WCAG/WAI-ARIA accessibility compliance
- Internationalization support (English, German, Spanish, French)
- Dark mode support

### Database & Data Management
- Cloudflare D1 SQLite database with automatic backups
- Drizzle ORM for type-safe database operations
- Database migration system with version control
- Optimistic locking with timestamp-based concurrency control
- Production and development database environments

### Development & Deployment
- 100+ unit tests with coverage reporting
- TypeScript type checking with watch mode
- Hot reload development server
- Cloudflare Workers deployment with rollback capabilities
- Real-time log streaming and database management tools
- Comprehensive build and deployment scripts

## Architecture Patterns

### Modular Route Structure
```
src/routes/
├── auth/          # OAuth authentication (Google/GitHub)
├── product/       # Example CRUD feature (replaceable)
└── helper/        # Shared utilities and middleware
```

### Dependency Injection
- TypeDI container for service management
- Environment and database injection
- Clean separation of concerns

### Server-Side Rendering
- All HTML generated server-side using JSX
- Type-safe route parameters and templates
- Component-based UI architecture
- HTMX for progressive enhancement

### Security Implementation
- Multi-layered security with defense in depth
- Input validation and sanitization
- Secure session management
- Protection against common web vulnerabilities

## Project Structure

```
├── client/src/          # Client-side TypeScript (HTMX extensions)
├── migrations/          # Database migration files
├── public/              # Static assets (CSS, images, JavaScript)
├── src/
│   ├── config/          # Application configuration
│   ├── db/              # Database schema and types
│   ├── htmx/            # HTMX utilities and helpers
│   ├── i18n/            # Internationalization
│   └── routes/          # Route controllers
├── tests/               # Unit tests
└── wrangler.jsonc       # Cloudflare Workers configuration
```

## Use Cases & Applications

This template is ideal for:
- **SaaS Applications**: Multi-tenant web applications with authentication
- **Admin Dashboards**: Secure backend interfaces with CRUD operations
- **E-commerce**: Product catalogs with user management
- **Content Management**: Authoring systems with role-based access
- **Enterprise Applications**: Internal tools with OAuth integration

## Getting Started Workflow

1. **Setup**: Clone repository, install Bun, configure OAuth credentials
2. **Development**: Run local server with hot reload, apply database migrations
3. **Testing**: Execute comprehensive test suite with coverage reporting
4. **Deployment**: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers with database provisioning
5. **Monitoring**: Stream logs and manage production database

## Security Considerations

The application implements enterprise-grade security:
- OAuth2 flows with state validation and PKCE support
- Signed cookies preventing session tampering
- CSRF protection on all state-changing operations
- Content Security Policy preventing XSS attacks
- Fetch Metadata protection against cross-site request forgery
- Input validation and sanitization
- Secure headers and cookie configuration

## Performance & Scalability

- **Edge Computing**: Runs on Cloudflare's global network
- **Server-Side Rendering**: Optimal for SEO and initial load times
- **HTMX**: Minimizes JavaScript bundle size and complexity
- **SQLite**: Efficient for most CRUD applications (10GB limit per instance)
- **Bun**: Fast package manager and test runner

## Customization & Extension

The template is designed for easy customization:
- Replace the products table with your domain models
- Add new features following the established patterns
- Extend authentication with additional OAuth providers
- Customize UI components and styling
- Add new languages for internationalization
- Implement additional security measures as needed

## Production Readiness

This is not a toy project but a production-ready template featuring:
- Comprehensive error handling and logging
- Database migration management
- Security hardening and best practices
- Testing infrastructure with high coverage
- Deployment automation and rollback capabilities
- Monitoring and observability tools
- Documentation and troubleshooting guides

The application serves as a solid foundation for building secure, scalable web applications that can be deployed globally on Cloudflare's edge network.
